policy.explicit: dx_dxfSourceTextPolicy::RequireValidSource, independently supplied by main to fileExport; Compatible remains ordinary adapter default
policy.admission: successful returned import, no original throw/legacy error/primary diagnostic failure, available bounded diagnostics, nonsaturated observations and no observed issue bits
policy.metadata: full owned raw HEADER declaration, not metadata prefix or canonical/exact naming category, determines legacy UTF8/UTF16 ineligibility
policy.positives: decoder-independent ASCII/represented CIF/MIF with missing/unknown/inexact page metadata; valid modern UTF8 with inert legacy metadata; no revision is invented
policy.negatives: malformed UTF8/CIF/Unicode scalars, undefined/DBCS sequences, observed replacement/discard, unresolved escapes, nonASCII inexact/unavailable/unknown/unspecified selection, unsupported legacy Unicode profiles
policy.cumulative: reader-only appended UnspecifiedSourceVersion and UnsupportedEncodingProfile issue kinds prevent later revision/page metadata from erasing earlier decoding ambiguity; old issue ordinals remain
policy.unknownRevision: raw nonASCII semantic decoding without an accepted source revision is recorded at decode time; ASCII/represented escapes can remain eligible without one
policy.profile: well-formed scalar output from an even-length ASCII pair under UTF16 is still an unsupported DXF profile; modern metadata is inert and DWG TU is unchanged
policy.publication: source gate runs at fileExport entry before output transaction/planning/emission; refusal preserves absent/existing destinations and does not mutate owned import evidence
policy.reporting: bounded constant ASCII reason plus uint32 issue mask on stderr; reporting exceptions cannot authorize publication
policy.compatibility: ordinary facade read bool/error/text/projection and Compatible adapter export remain; no installed policy API or pure virtual added
policy.boundary: necessary observed required-source-text gate only; not complete semantic coverage, mapping oracle, raw-carrier, target, DWG or native-consumer support
